data_cutoff_semantics: Exclusive boundary of historical file, not acquisition or current quote
limitations: Already-exposed one-day development sample; no holdout, causal effect or predictive efficacy claim.
Next-open and terminal-close are research proxies without actual executable ordering, fill, latency or depth evidence.
Confirmation has one-minute less exposure and skips some events; delayed-unconditional comparison isolates timing and filter arithmetically, not statistically.
All fee/slippage cases are scenarios; realized funding, mark-equity, actual trading cost and actual net PnL stay unknown.
Price extrema do not specify intrabar chronology; close-sampled drawdown may understate intrabar drawdown.
0.001 BTC is fixed normalized exposure, not current verified exchange-order eligibility.
Greedy nonoverlap selection and 20/30 minute design limit scope; no parameter search or strategy selection performed.
